verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows passing references that Treasury pairs with 'Issuing' (e.g., embeddable 'bill pay, issuing, and cash rewards' components, and 'fraud exposure within Treasury and Issuing') confirming card issuance is part of the ecosystem, but no documentation here details virtual/physical card issuance via API, spend controls, or digital wallet provisioning. Missing for 10: explicit card issuance API details tied to financial accounts, spend-control configuration docs, and digital wallet (Apple/Google Pay) support evidence.
